scope: Resolve the highest-priority open stern.py effect-semantics ambiguity from current Triggerword-5 ingest state; add exact enforcement atoms for Perception Control and Realtime pending-tool cancellation; cross-check VoiceSessionCapsule policy coupling without granting whole-runtime credit.

atoms.what_it_does: For state-changing tools, zulassen() computes capability, session-generation, target precondition and same-session idempotency status, then writes one effects row and links its effect_id through active_turns. Crucially, the enclosing source explicitly states that this PreToolUse path never returns deny/block and never prevents the tool from running; rejected/repeated/unverified are journal classifications, not execution authorization.
atoms.why_it_exists: Adds pre-execution effect bookkeeping and correlation with later PostToolUse verification while preserving the historical nonblocking hook behavior.
dependencies: external blocking guard referenced in source but not inspected in this packet
atoms.failure_mode: A consumer can misread status='ABGELEHNT' as prevented execution even though the underlying tool still runs. Unknown/timeout paths can leave no pre-row until PostToolUse fallback. This is incompatible with treating this function alone as EntityOS EffectGate authority.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Idempotency search is scoped to previously VERIFIED effects in the same session; concurrent same-action calls before verification are not proven serialized by this span.
atoms.privacy_implication: Target/argv go through redaction helpers before persistence in this path.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Designed for the tight PreToolUse hook budget; fail-silent on exception.
atoms.state_lifetime: effects rows durable; active_turns link session/episode scoped
known_counterevidence: The source references an older separate blocking guard outside this inspected mechanism; its current reachability/authority is unresolved here.
No tool execution was performed in this Triggerword-5 run.
supersedes: TW5-CONTRADICTION-EFFECT-SEMANTICS-002 partial unknown about whether PreToolUse admission itself blocks execution
open_questions: Map cmd_hook exact dispatch and the older external blocking guard; design Frankenstein-2.0 so deterministic EffectGate can actually deny/hold a real effect before execution while preserving a separate append-only EffectJournal.
Define unknown-outcome behavior for transport loss after submission; do not replay blindly.

atoms.what_it_does: PostToolUse merken() hashes/inspects the observed tool result, appends a durable_memory event row, updates the pre-existing effects row to VERIFIED/FEHLGESCHLAGEN only when its prior status was ZUGELASSEN, preserves ABGELEHNT/WIEDERHOLUNG/UNGEPRUEFT as classifications while appending the actual outcome, falls back to creating an effect row if PreToolUse produced none, and appends causal_episodes with credit=0 and reentered=0.
atoms.why_it_exists: Correlates a requested/preclassified action with its post-execution observable result without equating request with effect success.
reads: resulting target file for write/edit hash
atoms.failure_mode: Because the pre-stage is nonblocking, an effects row that remains ABGELEHNT can still receive an actual post-execution outcome. Status alone therefore does not encode whether execution happened. Fallback rows also cannot prove a pre-execution admission decision occurred.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Correlation relies on one active_turns.effect_id per session; overlapping state-changing tool calls must be traced for overwrite/race behavior before reuse.
atoms.privacy_implication: Persisted tool input/response is shortened/redacted; file outcomes are represented by bytes/hash where applicable.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Local hashing/SQLite work in PostToolUse hot path; no model call required.
known_counterevidence: Source inspection establishes code semantics, not an independent host execution receipt in this run.
supersedes: TW5-CONTRADICTION-EFFECT-SEMANTICS-002 exact requested/executed/verified separation is now partially source-resolved
open_questions: Separate canonical EffectJournal from generic durable_memory event convenience while retaining one deterministic state authority.
Prove one-to-one correlation under concurrent tool activity and explicit UNKNOWN outcome states.

atoms.what_it_does: HeadPolicy mechanically derives compute/inference/memory/persistence permissions from ON/COMPUTE_OFF/OUTPUT_OFF/MEMORY_OFF. evaluate_head resolves semantic dependencies from the central DAG rather than trusting caller-supplied dependency lists; unknown heads, COMPUTE_OFF heads and taint-blocked dependencies return NOT_COMPUTED with value=None before compute_fn can run.
atoms.why_it_exists: Makes perception disablement and privacy/taint semantics causally enforceable instead of representational, and prevents missing computation from being confused with a negative observation.
writes: perception_head_status for status bookkeeping when enabled
atoms.failure_mode: The guarantee holds only for callers that route perception through evaluate_head; raw compute_fn calls elsewhere would bypass it and must be reachability-audited.
atoms.concurrency_implication: RetinaPolicySnapshot is designed to give one registry snapshot per cycle; full caller adherence remains a separate reachability question.
atoms.privacy_implication: COMPUTE_OFF prevents the sensitive axis from being evaluated; OUTPUT_OFF blocks egress; MEMORY_OFF blocks persistence/memory matching.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Denied heads avoid compute cost entirely.
atoms.state_lifetime: policy durable; computed evidence cycle-scoped unless persistence allowed
known_counterevidence: Several current detector compute functions are explicitly simple keyword/regex scaffolds; policy enforcement sophistication must not be confused with classifier sophistication.
open_questions: Promote the same typed NOT_COMPUTED/dependency-taint semantics into sparse WorldNeed/WorldSlice materialization and GRID cell controls without persisting sensitive dense vectors.

atoms.what_it_does: Records a project measurement in which object.known.cup was set COMPUTE_OFF, a real /dev/video0 frame traversed the vision path, the target head returned NOT_COMPUTED/value=null, and the control person.presence head returned OK on the same frame; the persisted status table was then reported as matching.
atoms.why_it_exists: Provides bounded causal evidence that the COMPUTE_OFF gate can prevent computation while an allowed control head remains active.
writes: historically recorded perception status during the reported run
dependencies: historical NVIDIA vision call reported in the receipt
atoms.failure_mode: This archived receipt is not an independent reexecution in the current Triggerword-5 run and does not prove whole visual cortex, GRID10 or Frankenstein runtime acceptance.
atoms.privacy_implication: Demonstrates gate behavior at one component/control condition, not comprehensive privacy coverage.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Receipt includes a low-latency control-head evaluation but the semantic vision call was external and is historical evidence only.
known_counterevidence: No independent rerun in this packet.
open_questions: Reproduce equivalent taint/NOT_COMPUTED behavior inside GRID10 WorldSlice generation when an authorized future runtime test surface exists.

atoms.what_it_does: Builds an ephemeral VoiceSessionCapsule from fresh presence/visual/state/memory/arbitration sources on each refresh, reads privacy policy from perception_control, and points downstream disallowed-tools metadata at the same gespraechsmodus._GEFAEHRLICHE_WERKZEUGE object rather than maintaining a copied list.
atoms.why_it_exists: Compiles current session context for expression without creating a second durable voice-memory authority and reduces policy-description drift.
reads: unified.db through stern and visual/memory readers
atoms.failure_mode: If a caller treats capsule contents as independent truth or lets a stale capsule persist across decision-relevant state changes, the projection can diverge from canonical sources. Import failures also fail open to reduced context.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Refresh reads several live sources without an explicit cross-source transaction snapshot; exact temporal consistency is not guaranteed by this span.
atoms.privacy_implication: Capsule carries summarized/reference state and privacy policy rather than raw dense perception data; policy metadata is sourced from the live registry.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Each refresh performs fresh local reads/arbitration; no independent model is required for capsule construction itself.
known_counterevidence: Source reachability is established; this Triggerword-5 run did not execute a live Realtime session.
open_questions: For Frankenstein-2.0 define a typed consistent-read contract or generation stamp across state/presence/privacy inputs before the projection is allowed to steer expression.

atoms.what_it_does: Queues function_call items until response.done; if the server marks the response non-completed, all queued calls are discarded. Barge-in handling also clears queued tool calls before truncating/cancelling the audio response, preventing a tool request emitted by an interrupted thought from executing afterward.
atoms.why_it_exists: Aligns effect execution with what survived the conversational turn rather than executing function calls from a response the user interrupted.
outputs: execute queued tool calls only for completed responses; otherwise discard
atoms.failure_mode: This protects the Realtime voice path only; it is not a general canonical EffectGate and does not address effects already submitted before transport uncertainty.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Pending calls are session-local in-memory state; event ordering between function_call item, barge-in and response.done is explicitly guarded twice.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Cheap local queue clear plus websocket truncate/cancel.
tests_or_receipts: source comments reference historical real API truncate verification, not independently rerun here
known_counterevidence: No current live websocket execution in this packet.
open_questions: Generalize the principle as a typed pending-effect lease/cancellation state before EffectGate submission; keep UNKNOWN for effects whose external submission may already have happened.

hypotheses: Frankenstein-2.0 should split the current stern notion called EffectGate into an actual deterministic pre-effect authority plus an append-only outcome journal; the existing nonblocking classification/journal code is a useful donor but not sufficient authority.

Perception Control's COMPUTE_OFF/OUTPUT_OFF/MEMORY_OFF and dependency-taint semantics are a direct donor for GRID10/Cognitive-Twin control knobs and sparse WorldSlice materialization because they preserve NOT_COMPUTED as distinct from false/zero.
Realtime barge-in cancellation is a reusable pending-effect principle: a candidate/tool call can be invalidated before dispatch when the parent cognitive turn is cancelled or superseded.

VoiceSessionCapsule is best retained as an ephemeral compiler/view over canonical sources, with generation stamps added for Frankenstein-2.0 rather than turning it into an autonomous memory/state store.
counterhypotheses: A separate external blocking guard may already provide the actual pre-effect authority missing from stern.zulassen(); until its current reachability is traced, the whole Frank effect architecture must not be described as nonblocking.

Perception Control's central evaluate_head enforcement can be bypassed if any live caller invokes raw compute functions directly; source-wide reachability must be audited before promoting the pattern to system-wide privacy credit.

Cross-source VoiceSessionCapsule refresh can assemble temporally inconsistent inputs; a single generation stamp or transactional projection may be required before using it for stronger autonomous decisions.
Discarding pending tool calls on response cancellation only protects pre-dispatch calls; it does not solve unknown outcomes after an external effect request has already been submitted.
contradictions: TW5-CONTRADICTION-EFFECT-SEMANTICS-002-RESOLVED-PARTIAL: stern.py source explicitly says zulassen()/PreToolUse never blocks a tool. Therefore its ABGELEHNT/WIEDERHOLUNG/UNGEPRUEFT statuses are pre-effect journal classifications, not proof of prevented execution. PostToolUse verifies actual outcomes separately. Remaining unknown: whether the separately referenced older blocking guard is current/reachable and how authority composes across both paths.
